    view_size = observation.get('view_size', 0)
    
    # Determine current position
    my_x = me.get('x', 0)

    left_bound = max(my_x - view_size, 0)

    def in_bounds(x, y):
        return 0 <= y < len(grid) and 0 <= x < len(grid[0])
    
    # Function to check if cell is walkable (empty)
    def is_empty(x, y):
        if not in_bounds(x, y):
            return False
        cell = grid[y][x]
        return cell == 0 or cell is None

def choose_move(observation):

    width, height = observation['grid_width'], observation['grid_height']
